newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Land unit close to hotel deal.
newsitem.headline: Israel Land unit close to hotel deal.

text.p: An Israel Land Development Co (ILDC) official said on Thursday its Hachsharat Hayishuv Hotels Ltd unit is close to reaching a franchise deal with a large American hotel group.
The accord would cover Hachsharat's six existing hotels and grant it the right to franchise the name to other hotels in the Middle East, Hachsharat chairman Shlomo Grofman told Reuters.
He declined to name the group, but the Israeli financial daily Globes said it was the Howard Johnson franchise of HFS Inc.
"This is a master franchise deal letting us operate our hotels under the franchise's name and decide which other hotels will use the name," Grofman said.
He said the agreement would be formally announced within a month. Hackshat Hayishuv Hotels is 79 percent owned by ILDC.
